term: start a brief from this plan type
definition: Opens Brief Intake with the style and this plan diagram already named in the brief. The composer then guarantees the diagram a place among the candidates it returns; everything else the brief needs is still yours to state.
basis: Our wording of the link from a style's plan types to the brief. schema/brief.schema.json, the description of `parti`: "A plan diagram the composer must offer", and "The named parti is GUARANTEED A PLACE among the contrasting candidates"; and "Leave unset and the composer chooses every diagram itself." The two fields the brief still requires are its own: schema/brief.schema.json, "What a client asks for. Deliberately short".
